[B1] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), 'key' : Key, ...), ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' CloudX
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), 'key' : Key, ...), ... > $ CloudX 'sendKey' UserX | Key if Key =/= nils .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils, ... > $ CloudX 'sendKey' UserX | Key
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key, ... > .
[B2] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), ...), ... > $ UserX 'delegateAccess' CloudX | (DeviceX; UserY)
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Trusted), ...), ... > .
[B3] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusted' : (UserX, UserY, Trusted), ...), ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' CloudX | (DeviceX; UserY)
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), ...), ... > .
[B4] < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('key' : Key, 'trusted' : Trusted, ...), ... > $ UserX 'provideKey' cloudSmartThing | (DeviceX; Key)
=> < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('key' : Key, 'trusted' : (UserX, Trusted), ...), ... > .
[B6] < CloudX | DeviceX : ('on' : false, 'trusted' : (P, Trusted), ...), ... > $ P 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < CloudX | DeviceX : ('on' : true, 'trusted' : (P, Trusted), ...), ... > $ CloudX 'turnOn' DeviceX .
[B7] < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('bound' : B, ...), ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' DeviceX
=> < cloudSmartThing | DeviceX : ('bound' : B, ...), ... > $ cloudSmartThing 'turnOn' B .
[B8] < deviceLock | 'trusted' : (P, Trusted), 'on' : false, ... > $ P 'turnOn' deviceLock
=> < deviceLock | 'trusted' : (P, Trusted), 'on' : true, ... > .
